blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reliable brain-mask transfer into native fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) space can fail when T1-to-FLAIR rigid registration is unstable. We developed A$^3$PreCore, a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-registration strategy that aligns the full bias-corrected T1-weighted image to native FLAIR using normalized mutual information while preserving the established T1-space anatomical mask. We also introduced extended quantitative quality control (E-QC), which characterizes mask extent, field-of-view-relative position, FLAIR intensity support, boundary support, inferior morphology, and pairwise geometric disagreement. In 78 participants with paired T1-weighted and FLAIR imaging, A$^3$PreCore was compared with fsl_anat and the Brain Extraction Tool (BET). Gross rigid-body misregistration occurred in 21/78 fsl_anat outputs (26.9%) and 0/78 A$^3$PreCore outputs (exact two-sided McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7). Among 57 participants without gross fsl_anat misregistration, A$^3$PreCore preserved close agreement (median Dice=0.993; median paired Delta NMI=-0.00007, p=0.429). A$^3$PreCore remained broadly concordant with BET (median Dice=0.955), with less inferior and extracranial extension in representative comparisons. Method-blinded neuroscientists ranked A$^3$PreCore first in 35/40 participants (87.5%). E-QC additionally exposed severe orientation-related disagreement not evident from global descriptors or centroid displacement alone. These findings support A$^3$PreCore as a robust native-FLAIR brain-mask transfer strategy and E-QC as a complementary framework for multidimensional mask characterization and participant-specific geometric quality control.
blocks.zh: 当T1到FLAIR刚性注册不稳定时,可靠的脑浆转移到原生流体增压倒置回收(FLAIR)空间可能会失败. 我们开发了A^3$PreCore,这是一种六度自由僵硬的注册策略,利用正常的相互信息,将完全偏差修正的T1加权图像与本地FLAIR联系起来,同时保留既定的T1-空间解剖面具。 我们还引入了扩大的定量质量控制(E-QC),其特征是遮盖范围、视野相对位置、FLAIR强度支持、边界支持、劣质形态以及对等几何差异。 在78名配对的T1加权成像和FLAIR成像的参与者中,A^3$PreCore被比作fsl_anat和脑提取工具(BET). 21/78 Fsl_anat产出(26.9%)和0/78 A^3 A$PreCore产出(确切的说是双面的McNemar p=9.54 x 10^-7)中出现粗刚体错误登记。 在57名没有粗略错误注册的参与者中,A^3美元PreCore保留了近距离协议(中间点为Dice=0.993;中间对数的Delta NMI=-0.00007,p=0.429)。 A$3PreCore与BET(中间点=0.955)大致一致,在代表性比较中,低级和外延性较低。 方法盲神经科学家在35/40名参与者中排名A^3$PreCore第一(87.5%). 此外,E-QC还暴露了仅从全球描述或百分数迁移中看不出的与定向有关的严重分歧。 这些结论支持A^3$PreCore作为强大的本土-FLAIR脑罩传输战略,支持E-QC作为多层面面具特征和参与者特定几何质量控制的补充框架.

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: 1.1  Clinical and Methodological Importance of Native FLAIR-Space Brain Masking
blocks.zh: 1.1 原始FLAIR-空间脑面具的临床和方法重要性

blocks.en:
Fluid-attenuated inversion recovery (FLAIR) magnetic resonance imaging is
central to lesion-oriented neuroimaging because suppression of
cerebrospinal-fluid signal increases the conspicuity of abnormalities in
periventricular, juxtacortical, and deep white matter [ 1 , 2 ] . FLAIR is therefore widely used to characterize white matter hyperintensities
(WMHs), lacunar and periventricular abnormalities, edema, gliosis, and
demyelinating lesions across aging, cerebral small-vessel disease,
multiple sclerosis (MS), neurodegeneration, and other neurological disorders [ 3 , 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ] . WMHs, in
particular, are associated with stroke, cognitive impairment, dementia, and
disruption of white-matter integrity, making reliable FLAIR-based
quantification important in both clinical research and population
neuroimaging [ 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 , 13 , 14 ] .

blocks.en:
Because lesion segmentation and regional lesion-burden estimation are
commonly performed directly in native FLAIR space, many analysis workflows
require or benefit from restricting the image to a reliable intracranial
region. Numerous automated
lesion-segmentation approaches have been developed, including probabilistic,
conventional machine-learning, and deep-learning methods [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 22 ] . Irrespective of the downstream algorithm,
however, errors in the native FLAIR-space brain mask may propagate into
lesion volume, regional distribution, boundary measurements, and subsequent
statistical analyses. These effects are particularly relevant near cortical,
juxtacortical, periventricular, cerebellar, and inferior brain boundaries,
where lesion signal and mask errors may occur in close spatial proximity.
Reliable native-space brain masking is therefore an important methodological
requirement for reproducible lesion-focused FLAIR analysis.

blocks.en: 1.2  Challenges of Brain-Mask Generation in Native FLAIR Space
blocks.zh: 1.2 土著FLAIR中脑袋生成的挑战 空间

blocks.en:
Generating a reliable brain mask directly from FLAIR remains challenging
because the sequence combines substantial cross-modal tissue-contrast
differences with heterogeneous acquisition geometry and
pathology-dependent signal variation. Raw FLAIR images may contain skull,
scalp, neck, spinal-cord signal, background artifacts, intensity
inhomogeneity, incomplete head coverage, or motion-related distortion.
These characteristics vary across scanners, acquisition protocols, head
positions, and fields of view and can alter the apparent separation between
intracranial and extracranial tissue.

blocks.en:
Previous work has shown that brain extraction is sensitive to image
modality, acquisition quality, anatomical coverage, and pathology [ 23 , 24 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] . In native FLAIR space, direct
extraction may therefore produce inferior extracranial extension, inclusion
of low-signal non-brain tissue, or exclusion of cortical, temporal,
cerebellar, or inferior brain regions. Importantly, these defects can remain
spatially localized: a mask may retain a plausible total volume and centroid
while containing boundary abnormalities that are consequential for regional
lesion analysis. Evaluation based only on global mask characteristics may
therefore fail to detect clinically or methodologically relevant local
errors. Robust assessment should consequently consider both global mask
characteristics and localized boundary behaviour.

blocks.en: 1.3  Limitations of T 1 -to-FLAIR Brain-Mask Transfer
blocks.zh: 1.3 T 1 - 对FLAIR脑罩转移的限制

blocks.en:
An alternative strategy is to define a brain mask from the T 1 -weighted
image and propagate it into native FLAIR space. T 1 -weighted images provide
strong anatomical contrast and are well suited to brain-mask definition using
established anatomical-processing tools. Among these, FSL’s Brain Extraction
Tool (BET) is one of the most widely used approaches for brain extraction from
T 1 -weighted MRI and also provides a relevant reference method for the
comparisons performed in the present study [ 23 , 31 , 32 ] .
This strategy separates anatomical mask definition from the modality in which
lesions are ultimately quantified and can preserve a previously established
anatomical mask across modalities.

blocks.en: 1.4  Rationale for Robust T 1 -to-FLAIR Rigid Registration
blocks.zh: 1.4 强力T1 - 对法尔的理由 严格登记

blocks.en:
A 3 PreCore was developed to improve the robustness of the
transformation-estimation stage while preserving the anatomical brain mask
established in T 1 space. Rather than relying on a skull-stripped
T 1 image during transformation estimation, A 3 PreCore
uses the full bias-corrected T 1 -weighted image as the moving image and
the raw native FLAIR image as the fixed image. The full T 1 image retains
skull, scalp, head shape, and surrounding anatomical structures that are
also represented in the raw FLAIR image, thereby providing more comparable
spatial support across the two modalities.

原始的FLAIR图像作为固定图像。 完整 T1 图像保留
颅骨、头皮、头部形状和周围解剖结构
也出现在原始的FLAIR图像中,从而提供了比较的
两种模式的空间支持。

blocks.en: A 3 PreCore further performs six-degree-of-freedom rigid registration using normalized mutual information. Translation and rotation are estimated jointly as components of the subject-specific T 1 -to-FLAIR transformation, allowing the optimization procedure to determine the relative pose that best aligns the full T 1 -weighted image with native FLAIR. This optimization-based strategy is intended to reduce convergence to grossly displaced translational or rotational solutions under challenging imaging conditions. The resulting participant-specific transformation is then applied to the same T 1 -derived anatomical brain mask used in the fsl_anat comparison. A 3 PreCore therefore modifies transformation estimation rather than redefining the underlying anatomical source mask.

blocks.en:
This design leads to two complementary methodological questions. First, can
the proposed registration strategy reduce gross rigid-body misregistration
when conventional T 1 -to-FLAIR transfer fails? Second, does it preserve
close mask geometry when fsl_anat already produces a successful
registration? The second question is essential for distinguishing targeted
registration robustness from indiscriminate modification of the transferred
mask. A robust method should preferentially avoid severe participant-specific
failures while leaving already satisfactory registrations largely unchanged.

blocks.en: 1.5  Need for Multidimensional Quantitative Quality Control
blocks.zh: 1.5 多层面质量控制的必要性

blocks.en:
Visual inspection remains important for neuroimaging quality control, but it
is time-consuming, potentially subjective, and difficult to standardize in
large or multisite datasets. Automated QC methods can provide reproducible
indicators and reduce manual-review burden [ 41 , 42 ] . Their interpretation,
however, depends on the type of processing output being evaluated.
Acquisition-level tools such as MRIQC were not designed to validate derived
brain-mask geometry, and global morphological outlier strategies may miss
localized processing defects or exclude biologically plausible observations [ 42 , 43 ] . Measures such as mask
volume, centroid position, compactness, or mean within-mask intensity can
identify extreme deviations, but they may remain insensitive to localized
cortical exclusion, inferior extracranial extension, or spatially coherent
boundary displacement.

blocks.en:
Pairwise overlap measures provide complementary but incomplete information.
Dice and Jaccard coefficients summarize spatial agreement but do not
explicitly encode the anatomical location, spatial arrangement, or physical
distance of disagreement [ 44 , 45 ] . Boundary- and
distance-based measures are therefore important when local surface
displacement is relevant. Moreover, in the absence of an independently
delineated manual reference, overlap between two automatically generated
masks cannot determine which mask is anatomically more accurate. Low overlap
establishes disagreement, whereas high overlap does not exclude systematic
errors shared by both methods. Pairwise overlap should therefore be
interpreted as inter-method agreement rather than as ground-truth accuracy.

blocks.en:
Transfer-based workflows require an additional distinction between intrinsic
mask plausibility and registration geometry. Dedicated registration-QC
studies have used standardized visual protocols, anatomically specific
overlap measures, and learned classifiers to identify failed alignments [ 46 , 47 , 48 ] .
Mutual information and normalized mutual information are established
multimodal registration criteria [ 49 , 50 ] , but they do not directly encode
anatomical landmarks or localized boundary correspondence. When the same or
a related similarity criterion is used during optimization, it should not be
interpreted as independent evidence of anatomical correctness.

研究使用了标准化的视觉协议,解剖上的具体

blocks.en:
Accordingly, this study developed and applied a multidimensional extended
quantitative quality-control framework (E-QC) for native FLAIR-space brain
masks. E-QC separates method-specific mask characterization from pairwise
geometric characterization. The method-specific component retains
complementary descriptors of physical mask extent, field-of-view-relative
position, FLAIR intensity support, boundary-gradient support, and inferior
morphology. The pairwise component characterizes participant-specific
disagreement using relative volume difference, physical centroid
displacement, PCA-derived principal-axis orientation difference, and
PCA-orientation-induced boundary displacement.

blocks.en: 1.6  Study Contributions
blocks.zh: 1.6 研究贡献

blocks.en:
This study makes four principal contributions.
First, it introduces A 3 PreCore, an optimization-based rigid-registration strategy for native FLAIR-space brain-mask transfer that combines a full bias-corrected T 1 moving image with normalized-mutual-information-based six-degree-of-freedom transformation optimization while preserving the established T 1 -space anatomical source mask.

这项研究有四项主要贡献。
首先,它引入了A 3 PreCore,一种基于优化的刚性注册策略,用于原生FLAIR-空间脑罩转移,将完全偏移修正的T 1移动图像与正常的基于信息六度自由转换优化相结合,同时保留既定的T 1-空间解剖源面具.

blocks.en:
Second, the evaluation is explicitly designed to distinguish selective
registration robustness from broad or indiscriminate alteration of mask
geometry. In addition to determining whether A 3 PreCore
reduces gross rigid-body misregistration relative to fsl_anat ,
the analysis examines whether close registration and spatial agreement are
preserved in participants for whom fsl_anat already produces a
successful transfer. This distinction tests whether improved robustness is
concentrated in severe participant-specific failure cases rather than
reflecting a systematic departure from otherwise successful registrations.

Third, A 3 PreCore is compared with BET as a
registration-independent method that generates a brain mask directly in
native FLAIR space. This comparison evaluates overall spatial concordance
together with regional, boundary, directional, inferior, and extracranial
patterns of inter-method disagreement, including behaviour near the skull
base and upper cervical/neck extent. Because no independently delineated
native-FLAIR brain-mask reference was available, these comparisons are
interpreted as complementary evidence of inter-method agreement and
mask-boundary behaviour rather than as direct measurements of anatomical
accuracy.

Fourth, the study introduces E-QC as a multidimensional framework combining
scalar native-FLAIR mask plausibility with participant-level geometric
characterization. E-QC is evaluated together with controlled registration
analysis, volumetric and boundary-based agreement measures, regional and
slice-wise analyses, tri-planar qualitative assessment, and method-blinded
neuroscientist ranking. These complementary evaluation layers are intended
to determine whether scalar plausibility, spatial agreement, geometric
behaviour, and expert assessment converge on the same pattern of
registration robustness while identifying failure modes that may remain
hidden when any single quality measure is considered in isolation.

blocks.en: 3.1  Methodological Rationale

blocks.en:
A 3 PreCore was developed to address a geometric failure
mode in registration-based native-FLAIR preprocessing. A plausible anatomical
brain mask may be obtained in T 1 space, yet its final placement in native
FLAIR space depends on the transformation used for T 1 -to-FLAIR
registration. Anatomical mask definition and geometric mask placement were
therefore treated as distinct operations: the former determines which
T 1 -space voxels belong to the brain, whereas the latter determines where
that fixed anatomical mask is positioned after transformation to native
FLAIR space.

optimization schedule. No input masks, voxel-weighting images, cropping

transformation estimation.

blocks.en: 4.1  Rationale and Design Principles
blocks.zh: 4.1 理由和设计原则

blocks.en:
Conventional global quality-control measures may fail to identify
participant-specific abnormalities in automatically generated brain masks [ 51 , 42 , 52 ] .
A candidate mask may retain a plausible total volume, remain near the centre
of the acquisition field of view, and exhibit apparently reasonable FLAIR
signal characteristics while still being displaced, differently oriented,
or locally extended into non-brain tissue. Conversely, localized boundary
abnormalities may occur without producing marked changes in global mask
characteristics.

自动生成脑罩中参与者特有的异常[51,42,52].
候选人口罩可能保留一个合理的总体积,留在中心附近
并展示显然合理的FLAIR
信号特性虽然仍然在移动,但方向不同,
或局部扩展为非脑组织. 相反,局部边界
异常现象可能发生而不产生明显的全球面具变化
特性。

blocks.en:
These limitations are particularly relevant when comparing direct
FLAIR-space brain extraction with registration-based mask-transfer workflows.
A transferred mask may preserve a plausible global size and morphology despite
an incorrect T 1 -to-FLAIR transformation, whereas a directly generated
native-FLAIR mask avoids transformation-estimation failure but may remain
susceptible to modality-specific extraction errors.

blocks.en: 5  Experimental Evaluation
blocks.zh: 5 实验评价.

blocks.en: 5.1  Evaluation Design and Prespecified Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.1 评价设计和预先规定的比较

blocks.en:
The experimental evaluation addressed three complementary dimensions of
native-FLAIR brain-mask assessment: method-specific mask characterization,
fixed pairwise inter-method disagreement, and registration-related multimodal
similarity. Independently delineated manual brain masks in native FLAIR space
were not available. Accordingly, method-specific E-QC descriptors and
pairwise overlap, surface, regional, slice-wise, volumetric, and geometric
measures were interpreted as complementary characterizations of mask behaviour
and inter-method agreement rather than as estimates of anatomical accuracy.

试验性评价涉及三个相辅相成的方面:
原生-FLAIR脑罩评估:特定方法的面具特征,
固定对偶方法之间的分歧,以及与登记有关的多式联运
类似。 当地FLAIR空间内独立的人工脑罩
没有。 因此,特定方法的E-QC描述符和
双向重叠、表面、区域、切片、体积和几何
措施被解释为对面具行为的补充定性
以及方法间协议,而不是作为解剖准确性的估计。

blocks.en: 5.5  Method-Blinded Expert Ranking of Brain-Mask Quality
blocks.zh: 5.5 采用方法的Blind专家排名

blocks.en:
A method-blinded expert assessment was performed in a random subset of
40 participants selected from the common 78-participant cohort. For each
participant, the native FLAIR image together with the three corresponding
native-FLAIR-space masks generated by A 3 PreCore, fsl_anat , and BET were provided separately to three
neuroscientists using neutral identifiers that concealed method identity.
The evaluation therefore comprised 120 candidate masks.

Each neuroscientist independently reviewed the masks in FSLeyes. Reviewers

free to choose the order in which the three candidate masks were inspected.
For each participant, the three masks were ranked from 1 to 3 according to
overall mask quality and anatomical plausibility, with rank 1 indicating the
preferred mask and rank 3 the least preferred mask.

未告知用哪种方法产生面具,而且

agreement, such that the ordering supported by at least two of the three

blocks.en:
Continuous outcomes were summarized using the number of evaluable
participants, mean, standard deviation, median, interquartile range, minimum,
and maximum. All method-level contrasts used participant-matched

Gross visual registration failure and controlled Δ ​ NMI \Delta\operatorname{NMI} were designated as the principal

geometric, regional, and slice-wise measures were used primarily to

blocks.en: 6  Results
blocks.zh: 6 结果

blocks.en:
The final analysis cohort comprised 78 participants with the imaging inputs
required for all workflows evaluated in the present study. The primary
methodological comparison was between A 3 PreCore and the fsl_anat ,
whereas BET served as a secondary direct native-FLAIR-space brain-masking
comparator. To maintain a common participation basis in the comparative
analyses, all three workflows were evaluated within the same
cohort of 78 participants.

blocks.en:
All three workflows were completed successfully in all 78 participants and
produced readable output masks. The generated masks matched the dimensions
and affine geometry of their corresponding native FLAIR images, and no
attempted workflow failed due to missing, unreadable, or
native-grid-incompatible output. Native-grid compatibility was treated as a
technical processing criterion and did not, by itself, establish correct
anatomical placement.

blocks.en: 6.1  Primary Outcome: Gross Rigid-Body Misregistration
blocks.zh: 6.1 初级结果:严重硬化-Body误登记

blocks.en:
The primary registration outcome was the occurrence of gross rigid-body
misregistration of the transferred brain mask in native FLAIR space. Using the participant-level assessment procedure described in the Methods,
gross misregistration was identified in 21 of the 78 fsl_anat outputs (26.9%). Independent review by three
neuroscientists was fully concordant: each reviewer independently
identified the same 21 fsl_anat outputs as showing gross
rigid-body misregistration. In contrast, none of the corresponding
A 3 PreCore outputs were classified as showing gross
rigid-body misregistration (0/78, 0.0%)
(Figure 4 4(b) ).

blocks.en:
The 21 fsl_anat failures comprised distinct rigid-body failure
patterns. Fourteen cases were classified as translation-dominant
(14/78, 17.9% of the complete cohort; 66.7% of fsl_anat failures),
one as rotation-dominant
(1/78, 1.3% of the complete cohort; 4.8% of fsl_anat failures),
and six as showing combined translational and rotational displacement
(6/78, 7.7% of the complete cohort; 28.6% of fsl_anat failures).
The failure subtypes were mutually exclusive and together accounted for all
21 fsl_anat gross-misregistration cases. The remaining 57 fsl_anat outputs
(57/78, 73.1%) showed no evident gross rigid-body misregistration.

blocks.en:
The paired comparison consequently showed an increase in the proportion of
gross-misregistration-free outputs from 57/78 (73.1%) with the fsl_anat workflow to 78/78 (100.0%) with A 3 PreCore. This
corresponded to an absolute paired increase of 26.9 percentage points.
The binary outcomes were discordant in 21 participants, and all 21
discordances occurred in the same direction: the fsl_anat output was
classified as grossly misregistered whereas the corresponding
A 3 PreCore output was not. The paired difference was
significant by the exact two-sided McNemar test
( p = 9.54 × 10 − 7 p=9.54\times 10^{-7} ).

the fsl_anat gross-misregistration subgroup had a corresponding
A 3 PreCore output that did not exhibit the same gross
rigid-body displacement. This observation is interpreted as a difference in
gross-registration robustness between the two workflows rather than as an
estimate of absolute anatomical accuracy, because no independently delineated
native-FLAIR-space brain-mask reference was available.

blocks.en:
The 21 fsl_anat failure cases were not removed from the primary
quantitative comparisons. Excluding these participants would condition the
analysis on successful fsl_anat registration and would therefore remove the
principal failure mode under evaluation. All 78 participants were instead
retained in the main between-workflow analyses, while the 21 fsl_anat gross-misregistration cases were additionally examined as a targeted subgroup
in subsequent quantitative and qualitative analyses. Because this subgroup
was defined using quantitative mask-disagreement information together with
tri-planar visual assessment, analyses stratified by fsl_anat registration
status were treated as descriptive characterization rather than as an
independent validation of anatomical accuracy.

blocks.en: 6.2  Ablation and Registration-Strategy Characterization
blocks.zh: 6.2 标记和登记-战略特征

blocks.en:
To characterize the contribution of each component of the
A 3 PreCore registration strategy to the prevention of
gross rigid-body misregistration, a controlled leave-one-component-out
ablation analysis was performed within the common 78-participant cohort.
The complete strategy combined three modifications relative to the fsl_anat reference configuration: registration of the full
bias-corrected T 1 image rather than the skull-stripped T 1 , use of
normalized mutual information (NMI) rather than mutual information (MI),
and extension of the angular search range to ± 90 ∘ \pm 90^{\circ} . Each
component was removed individually while the remaining two were retained.
Across all configurations, the native FLAIR reference, rigid-body degrees
of freedom, source brain mask, and mask-resampling procedure were held
constant, thereby restricting the comparison to the registration strategy
itself.

blocks.en:
Beyond the binary gross-misregistration endpoint, the resulting
registration transforms were characterized quantitatively using a
controlled NMI analysis. For this analysis, the fsl_anat and
A 3 PreCore transforms were reapplied to the same full
bias-corrected T 1 image and evaluated against the same native FLAIR
reference using identical preprocessing, histogram binning, and voxel
support. This controlled design removed differences in moving-image content
from the similarity evaluation itself. NMI was therefore interpreted as a
registration-similarity descriptor and not as an independent measure of
anatomical accuracy.

blocks.en:
Taken together, the registration-strategy analyses indicate that the
between-workflow differences were concentrated primarily in the subset of
participants in whom fsl_anat exhibited gross rigid-body
misregistration. In the remaining participants, the fsl_anat and
A 3 PreCore transforms showed closely matched controlled
NMI values. The NMI analysis therefore supports the primary
gross-misregistration findings as a mechanistic characterization of the
registration behaviour, while the spatial consequences of these differences
on the transferred brain masks are examined in the following section using
volumetric overlap, boundary-distance, and geometric measures.

blocks.en: 6.3  Spatial Agreement and Boundary Concordance
blocks.zh: 6.3 空间协议和边界协调

blocks.en:
Pairwise spatial agreement was examined to determine whether the increased
registration robustness of A 3 PreCore was accompanied by
substantial changes in the transferred brain mask when the fsl_anat did not exhibit gross rigid-body misregistration. Dice and Jaccard
coefficients were used to characterize volumetric overlap, whereas the
95th-percentile Hausdorff distance (HD95) and average symmetric surface
distance (ASSD) were used to characterize boundary disagreement. Directional
coverage and non-overlap measures were additionally used to describe the
spatial distribution of between-method differences. Because no independently
delineated native-FLAIR brain-mask reference was available, all such measures
were interpreted as measures of inter-method agreement rather than anatomical
accuracy.

The reduction in overlap within the fsl_anat gross-misregistration subgroup
does not, by itself, establish which of the two transferred masks was
anatomically more accurate. The direction of the observed disagreement was
therefore interpreted in conjunction with the prespecified participant-level
gross-misregistration assessment described in
Section 6.1 . All 21 participants in this
subgroup were classified as showing gross rigid-body misregistration in the fsl_anat output, whereas none of the corresponding
A 3 PreCore outputs showed the same gross displacement.
Accordingly, the subgroup-specific overlap and non-overlap results were
treated as descriptive characterization of the spatial consequences of the
identified fsl_anat registration failures rather than as independent
validation of anatomical accuracy.

The comparison with BET provided a complementary registration-independent
reference for characterizing agreement with a mask generated directly in
native FLAIR space, without implying anatomical ground truth. Notably,
substantial spatial and boundary disagreement could occur despite only
minimal differences in total mask volume, demonstrating that global volume
similarity alone was insufficient to characterize the observed registration
discrepancies. The geometric characteristics of these participant-specific
differences are examined in the following section.

All paired analyses were performed within the same 78-participant cohort
(Table 7 ).

Taken together, the scalar QC results show that the substantial reduction in
gross registration failure achieved by A 3 PreCore was not
accompanied by a broad deterioration in native-FLAIR mask plausibility.
At the same time, the close clustering and ceiling behaviour of several
scalar QC components demonstrate why a single global score is insufficient
to characterize the failure modes observed in this study. The principal
advantage of E-QC therefore lies in extending quality assessment beyond
global plausibility to explicitly characterize participant-specific spatial
and geometric disagreement. The geometric component of this profile is
examined in the following section, where centroid displacement,
PCA-derived orientation difference, and orientation-induced boundary
displacement reveal discrepancies that remained largely inconspicuous in the
scalar QC summaries.

blocks.en: 6.5  Geometric Characterization of Inter-Method Mask Disagreement
blocks.zh: 6.5 媒体间面具分歧的几何特征

blocks.en:
The method-specific E-QC descriptors in the preceding section
characterized each candidate mask independently, but did not directly
quantify geometric disagreement between methods. We therefore examined
three complementary pairwise descriptors: physical centroid displacement,
PCA-derived principal-axis orientation difference, and
PCA-orientation-induced boundary displacement. Together, these measures
separate differences in mask position from differences in dominant spatial
orientation and from the physical boundary-scale consequence of that
orientation disagreement. Because the PCA-based quantities were derived
from the geometry of the candidate masks, they were interpreted as
descriptors of inter-method disagreement rather than as direct estimates
of the underlying registration-transform parameters.

Taken together, the pairwise geometric analysis revealed a multidimensional

exhibiting participant-specific extremes. Because BET is generated directly
in native FLAIR space, this comparison provides a complementary

an anatomical reference standard.

blocks.en:
Collectively, the results demonstrate that the improved registration
robustness of A 3 PreCore was achieved without systematic
alteration of mask geometry in successfully registered cases.
The paired gross-misregistration analysis, spatial and boundary
measurements, multidimensional E-QC characterization, qualitative
comparisons, and blinded expert assessments provide complementary
evidence of this behaviour. A 3 PreCore maintained
close spatial agreement with successfully registered fsl_anat masks while avoiding the severe geometric
discrepancies observed in confirmed registration-failure cases.
Comparisons with BET further revealed differences in peripheral
and inferior mask extent, highlighting the complementary information
provided by spatially resolved evaluation. Together, these findings
support the robustness of A 3 PreCore for
T 1 -to-FLAIR brain-mask transfer, while distinguishing
inter-method agreement from independently established
anatomical accuracy.

blocks.en: 7  Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: 7.1  Principal Findings
blocks.zh: 7.1 主要调查结果

blocks.en:
This study evaluated A 3 PreCore as a full-T 1 -guided
strategy for transferring an established T 1 -space anatomical brain mask
into native FLAIR space. The principal finding was that successful workflow
execution did not necessarily ensure plausible geometric placement. All
attempted BET, fsl_anat , and A 3 PreCore workflows
produced output masks. However, gross rigid-body misregistration was identified
in 21 / 78 21/78 fsl_anat outputs and in none of the corresponding
A 3 PreCore outputs. Within the present cohort,
A 3 PreCore was therefore associated with substantially fewer
gross placement failures than the implemented fsl_anat .
blocks.zh:
这项研究评估了A 3 PreCore 的全T 1 - 指导
转移已建立的T1-空间解剖脑罩的战略
进入本地的FLAIR空间。 主要结论是工作流程成功
执行不一定能确保合理的几何位置。 全体
尝试了 BET、 fsl_anat 和 A 3 PreCore 工作流程
生产了输出口罩。 然而,已查明存在严重硬体错误登记
21/78 21/78 fsl_anat 输出,没有相应的产出
3 PreCore产出。 在目前的群体中,
因此,3个PreCore与少得多
与已执行的 fsl_anat 相比, 严重的放置失败 。

blocks.en:
The controlled registration analysis supported this finding while showing that
the difference was concentrated in a specific subset of participants. When the
transformations from both registration strategies were reapplied to the same
full bias-corrected T 1 -weighted image, the cohort-level NMI distributions
were closely matched. Nevertheless, every participant with

The spatial-agreement analyses provided complementary evidence.

blocks.en: 7.2  A 3 PreCore as a Full-T1-Guided Geometric-Transfer Strategy
blocks.zh: 7.2 3 PreCore作为全T1-Guided几何传输战略

blocks.en:
A 3 PreCore is an optimization-based geometric mask-transfer
method rather than a new brain-extraction or tissue-segmentation algorithm.
It does not redefine which T 1 -weighted voxels constitute brain tissue.
Instead, it searches over a six-degree-of-freedom rigid-transformation space
comprising three translational and three rotational parameters to identify
the location and orientation that provide the best normalized-mutual-information
score under the configured search and optimization procedure. The resulting
subject-specific transformation is then applied to the existing T 1 -space
anatomical mask. This distinction is important because transferred-mask quality
depends on two related but separable operations: definition of the source mask
and optimization of its placement in the target image. A plausible source mask
may produce an unusable native-FLAIR output when the estimated transformation
is incorrect, whereas an accurately estimated transformation cannot repair a
systematically inaccurate source-mask boundary.
blocks.zh:
A 3 PreCore 是一个基于优化的几何面具传输
方法,而不是新的脑切除或组织分隔算法。

blocks.en:
Both registration branches propagated the same T 1 -derived anatomical mask,
allowing placement differences to be assessed without introducing differences
in source-mask definition. The close agreement between
A 3 PreCore and fsl_anat in non-failure cases suggests that the
proposed workflow generally produced a closely concordant native-FLAIR mask
when fsl_anat registration was successful. Its main advantage was observed in
the subset in which the fsl_anat branch produced gross displacement. Any
systematic inclusion or exclusion already present in the T 1 -space source
mask will, however, also be inherited by the A 3 PreCore
output. The method should therefore be viewed as a complement to established
anatomical-processing pipelines rather than as a replacement for them.

blocks.en:
One possible explanation for the difference between the registration
strategies is the spatial support presented to the multimodal similarity
objective. In the fsl_anat , the moving image contains predominantly
skull-stripped brain tissue, whereas the fixed native FLAIR image may retain
skull, scalp, neck, head contour, inferior extracranial signal, and other
structures. The moving and fixed images therefore differ not only in tissue
contrast but also in the anatomical regions represented during transformation
estimation. This support mismatch may reduce the information available for
estimating global head position, particularly when the initial pose is unusual,
inferior coverage is extensive, or extracranial signal competes with
intracranial image structure.

The full bias-corrected T 1 image preserves global structures that are

The predominance of translation-dominant and combined failures in the fsl_anat branch is consistent with this interpretation.

The present comparison did not isolate the contribution of the full-T 1 representation alone. The workflows differed in three registration
components: the moving-image representation, similarity criterion, and
angular-search specification. fsl_anat used a skull-stripped

normalized mutual information, and an explicit ± 90 ∘ \pm 90^{\circ} search around
each axis. The observed difference should therefore be attributed to the
complete A 3 PreCore strategy as implemented rather than
exclusively to the presence of extracranial information.

The controlled NMI findings provide optimization-consistent support for this

measure may be insensitive to small but relevant boundary differences, and the
participant-level NMI direction depended partly on the voxel support used for
evaluation. NMI should therefore be interpreted alongside geometric measures
and visual review rather than as a stand-alone measure of anatomical validity.

A 3 PreCore is also restricted to rigid-body placement. This
choice is appropriate for correcting dominant differences in head pose between

blocks.en: 7.3  Multidimensional E-QC and Interpretation Without Manual Ground Truth
blocks.zh: 7.3 多层面电子质量控制和无人工地面真相解释

blocks.en:
The E-QC findings demonstrate why brain-mask assessment should not be
reduced to a single global measure. The six method-specific descriptors
( V V , C C , R I R_{I} , B G B_{G} , P peripheral P_{\mathrm{peripheral}} , and P tail P_{\mathrm{tail}} ) characterize complementary aspects of mask geometry,
image-derived support, and peripheral or inferior extent. A rigidly
displaced mask may retain a plausible total volume or FOV-relative centroid
position despite exhibiting geometrically implausible placement.
Conversely, two masks with high global overlap may differ in comparatively
small but spatially relevant boundary regions. Descriptor-level
characterization and global overlap therefore remain insufficient when
interpreted individually and should be considered alongside explicit
pairwise geometric measures.

The pairwise geometric coordinates provided information that was absent from

centroid-based assessment alone would not identify every gross geometric

Boundary, regional, and slice-wise analyses further separated global
agreement from local conformity. Large surface displacement could occur with

contribute relatively few voxels to the complete mask while potentially
affecting measurements near the cerebellum, brainstem, and inferior temporal
regions.

blocks.en:
The main value of E-QC in the present study was therefore not the production
of a single pass–fail score. Instead, the method-specific descriptors and
pairwise geometric coordinates distinguished different forms of disagreement,
identified participant-specific geometric abnormalities, revealed differences
concealed by volume and global overlap, and prioritized masks for targeted
tri-planar inspection. This multidimensional interpretation is particularly
useful when a method preserves broadly similar intracranial coverage while
differing in a comparatively small boundary region.

单传-不及格。 取而代之的是具体方法说明和
双向几何坐标 区分不同形式的分歧,

由数量和全球重叠所掩盖,并列为有目标的口罩的优先次序
三层飞机检查 这种多层面的解释尤其突出。

blocks.en:
Automatic agreement must nevertheless be interpreted cautiously when no
independent anatomical reference is available. Expert-derived masks generated
according to a prespecified protocol provide the most direct available basis
for estimating anatomical segmentation accuracy, although such references
remain subject to annotation decisions and inter-rater variability. Because
independently delineated native-FLAIR masks were unavailable, Dice, Jaccard,
surface distance, directional exclusive volume, regional agreement, and
pairwise geometric descriptors quantified relationships between automatic
outputs rather than absolute correctness.
blocks.zh:
然而,在下述情况下,必须谨慎解释自动协议:
提供了独立的解剖学参考。 生成的专家口罩
根据预先规定的协议,提供最直接可用的基础
用于估算解剖分解准确性,尽管这些参考文献

表面距离、定向专有量、区域协定和
双向几何描述符
产出而不是绝对正确。

blocks.en:
High agreement between two automatic methods is reassuring, particularly when
the methods use different sources of information, but it does not prove that
either output is anatomically correct. Both methods may share a systematic
boundary error. Conversely, low agreement confirms that the methods differ but
does not determine which boundary is preferable. This distinction is
particularly relevant to the A 3 PreCore–BET comparison
because one method transfers a T 1 -defined anatomical mask, whereas the
other estimates the brain boundary directly from FLAIR. Their disagreements
may reflect differences in modality, mask definition, dilation, local boundary
behaviour, or geometric placement.

两种自动方法之间的高度一致令人放心,特别是在
这些方法使用不同的信息来源,但不能证明
或输出在解剖学上是正确的。 这两种方法都可能具有系统性
边界错误。 相反,低协议证实方法不同,但

因为一种方法转移 T 1 定义的解剖面具,而

可能反映模式、掩码定义、扩展、本地边界的差异
行为,或几何位置。

blocks.en:
E-QC consequently occupies an intermediate position between automatic
agreement and independent anatomical annotation. Its method-specific
descriptors quantify complementary mask and mask-to-image characteristics,
whereas its pairwise geometric coordinates describe relative position,
orientation, and boundary-level disagreement. These measures can flag
suspicious outputs, reveal participant-specific geometric abnormalities,
and support interpretation of systematic boundary differences, but they
cannot replace voxel-level reference masks. Similarly, the
three-neuroscientist review provided important confirmation of gross
displacement but did not constitute independent manual delineation.
Claims of absolute anatomical superiority will therefore require
reference-based validation.
blocks.zh:
因此,E-QC在自动
协议和独立的解剖注释。 其具体方法
描述符量化互补的面具和面具到图像特性,
而它的对称几何坐标 描述相对位置,
定向和边界层面的分歧。 这些措施可以突出
显示参与者特有的几何异常
并支持对系统边界差异的解释,但它们
无法替换 voxel 级参考口罩。 同样,
三中微子科学家审查提供了重要证实毛额
但不构成独立的人工划界。
因此,声称绝对解剖优越性将要求
基于参考的验证。

blocks.en: 7.4  Relationship to Existing Methods and Pipeline Implications
blocks.zh: 7.4 与现有方法和管道影响的关系

blocks.en:
Established brain-extraction approaches include intensity- and
morphology-based methods, atlas and label-fusion techniques, hybrid anatomical
models, and learning-based systems [ 23 , 61 , 25 , 26 , 27 , 28 , 29 , 30 ] .
Direct FLAIR-space extraction has the practical advantage of requiring only
the target image and avoiding cross-modal registration failure. In the present
cohort, BET generated technically complete masks for all available FLAIR
images and showed high overall agreement with A 3 PreCore.
blocks.zh:
既定的人才采集方法包括强度和
形态学方法、地图集和标签组合技术、混合解剖学
和基于学习的系统[23、61、25、26、27、28、29、30]
直接FLAIR-空间提取具有实际好处,即仅要求
目标图像和避免跨模式登记失败。 目前
组合,BET为所有可用的FLAIR生产技术完整的口罩
图像和显示与A 3 PreCore的高度总体一致。

blocks.en:
The boundary-sensitive and regional analyses nevertheless identified
systematic differences between BET and A 3 PreCore,
particularly near peripheral and inferior mask regions. In representative
cases, greater BET-exclusive extent was concentrated near inferior boundaries
adjacent to the skull base, cervical region, and other extracranial
structures. High global overlap therefore reflected broadly similar
intracranial coverage but did not capture every local boundary difference
between the two methods. Because no manual native-FLAIR reference was
available, these findings describe relative boundary behaviour rather than
definitive anatomical superiority.
blocks.zh:
尽管如此,仍确定了对边界敏感和区域分析
BET和A 3 PreCore之间的系统差异,
特别是接近外围和低劣的面具区域。 代表
企业、技术和技术的排他性较强,集中在低等边界附近
靠近头骨基部、宫颈区域和其他外科
结构。 因此,全球高度重叠反映出大致相似
颅内覆盖,但没有记录所有当地边界差异
两种方法之间。 因为没有手工本地-FLAIR的参考文献
这些结论描述了相对边界行为,而不是
绝对的解剖优势。

blocks.en:
T 1 -guided transfer provides a complementary advantage by reusing masks
derived from a structural modality with strong anatomical contrast and mature
processing tools. Its principal vulnerability lies in the transformation
between modalities. A 3 PreCore addresses this stage without
replacing the source-mask algorithm or requiring a training dataset. It is
therefore compatible in principle with masks generated by FSL,
FreeSurfer-related workflows, atlas-based methods, or other validated
T 1 -processing pipelines, provided that the source mask and full
bias-corrected T 1 image share a consistent coordinate system.

blocks.en:
Learning-based extraction methods may capture complex local boundary features
that are unavailable to a rigid-transfer procedure. Their performance may,
however, depend on the training distribution, acquisition characteristics,
pathology representation, and deployment domain.
A 3 PreCore is comparatively simple, training-free, and
geometrically interpretable. These properties may facilitate integration into
existing pipelines and make failure modes easier to inspect, although they do
not establish superiority over modern learning-based systems. The present BET
comparison should also not be interpreted as a comprehensive benchmark against
all contemporary direct FLAIR or modality-agnostic extraction approaches.

More flexible registration methods, including boundary-based, symmetric,
affine, and nonlinear strategies, may further improve cross-modal alignment [ 33 , 34 , 35 , 36 , 37 , 38 ] .
The present method deliberately used rigid transformation to preserve source
anatomy while correcting global differences in pose. Whether greater
transformation flexibility provides additional benefit without introducing
unnecessary deformation, instability, or sensitivity to FLAIR pathology
remains to be established.

blocks.en:
A broader implication is that preprocessing validation should be divided into
explicit stages. Input availability, workflow completion, output readability,
native-grid compatibility, registration similarity, descriptor-level mask
plausibility, geometric placement, and local boundary conformity should not
be collapsed into a single success indicator. A workflow may generate an
apparently valid output while retaining a gross transformation error, and a
mask may have high Dice agreement or a similar volume while containing
systematic regional boundary differences.

blocks.en:
The findings support further evaluation of A 3 PreCore as a
registration-based branch when paired T 1 -weighted and FLAIR images are
available. Direct FLAIR extraction remains useful when a suitable T 1 image
or anatomical source mask is unavailable. Automated E-QC descriptors and
pairwise geometric coordinates could prioritize uncertain cases for
tri-planar review, whereas retaining the transformation matrix and registered
full-T 1 image would provide auditable intermediate outputs. These
safeguards would allow global placement and local boundary behaviour to be
assessed independently of file completion.

blocks.en:
Reliable mask placement is potentially relevant to FLAIR pipelines in which
brain masks are used before lesion segmentation, regional burden estimation,
radiomic analysis, or image normalization. Gross displacement may exclude
valid brain tissue or include background structures, whereas subtler inferior
and peripheral differences may affect regional measurements despite having
limited influence on global volume. The current findings establish an
important preprocessing distinction between technical completion and
geometric plausibility. Whether these differences improve downstream lesion
or clinical measurements remains to be determined.

blocks.en: 7.5  Limitations and Future Directions
blocks.zh: 7.5 限制和未来方向

blocks.en:
Several limitations define the interpretation and generalizability of the
findings. First, independently delineated native-FLAIR brain masks were
unavailable. The study could therefore assess technical completion, gross
placement, automatic agreement, image-derived plausibility, relative geometry,
and visually assessed boundary behaviour, but not absolute voxel-level
anatomical accuracy. The three-neuroscientist review strengthened the
assessment of gross displacement but did not constitute independent manual
delineation. Future validation should include native-FLAIR reference masks
generated under a prespecified protocol by multiple blinded reviewers,
including both routine cases and an enriched sample of suspected failures.
blocks.zh:
某些限制界定了国际法的解释和普遍性。
发现。 首先,独立划定的本地-FLAIR脑罩
无. 因此,研究可以评估技术完成情况,毛额
位置、自动协议、图像产生的可信度、相对几何、
和视觉评估的边界行为,但不是绝对的阴道水平
解剖准确性。 三中子科学家审查加强了
评估流离失所情况,但不构成独立的手册
划界。 未来的验证应包括本土-FLAIR参考口罩
由多个盲目审查员根据预先指定的协议生成,
包括常规案件和大量疑似失败的样本。

blocks.en:
Second, the comparison did not isolate the individual contributions of the
A 3 PreCore strategy. Moving-image representation, similarity
criterion, and angular-search range differed simultaneously between fsl_anat and A 3 PreCore. It is therefore not possible to
determine whether the reduction in gross misregistration arose primarily from
the full-T 1 image, normalized mutual information, expanded angular search,
or interactions among these factors. Prespecified ablation experiments should
vary these components independently while holding the remaining registration
settings constant.

或这些因素之间的相互作用。 预定的消化试验应
在保持剩余登记时独立改变这些组成部分
设置常数。

blocks.en:
Third, the study was conducted in a single-site cohort of older
community-dwelling adults. Scanner characteristics, acquisition protocols,
participant age, pathology burden, head pose, and field-of-view coverage may
affect both registration and direct FLAIR extraction. The observed fsl_anat failure rate and BET disagreement pattern should therefore not be generalized
directly to other datasets. External validation should include multiple sites,
scanners, protocols, age groups, and clinically relevant populations.
blocks.zh:
第三,这项研究是在单一地点的一组老年人中进行的。
社区居住成年人。 扫描仪特性, 获取协议,
参与者年龄、病理负担、头部姿势和视野覆盖

直接到其他数据集。 外部验证应包括多个网站,
扫描仪、协议、年龄组和临床相关人群。

blocks.en:
Fourth, A 3 PreCore is limited to rigid-body transformation.
Rigid registration preserves the geometry of the source mask. It is suitable
for correcting global pose, but it cannot address scale differences, shear,
nonlinear anatomical variation, or sequence-dependent distortion. Future
studies should compare the rigid strategy with affine, boundary-based,
distortion-aware, and nonlinear alternatives while assessing the risk of
introducing unnecessary or biologically inappropriate deformation.
blocks.zh:
第四,A 3 PreCore仅限于刚性的身体转变.
严格注册保留了源面罩的几何特征. 这是合适的
但是它不能解决尺度差异,缩小,
非线性解剖变异,或序列依赖扭曲。 未来
研究应当将僵硬的战略与基于边界的附属战略进行比较。

引入不必要的或生物学上不适当的变形。

blocks.en:
Fifth, E-QC remains exploratory. Its descriptor definitions and parameter
choices are heuristic, several measures may be correlated, and the
PCA-derived coordinates describe relative mask geometry rather than the
underlying transformation parameters. Although the present findings show
that multidimensional characterization can identify discrepancies missed by
global measures, no validated decision thresholds for automated acceptance
or rejection were established. Calibration and validation should therefore
be performed using independent datasets and blinded reference assessments.

blocks.en:
Sixth, interpretation of local boundary differences relied on the convergence
of boundary-sensitive measures and visual review rather than manual
voxel-level ground truth. The findings support systematic differences between
the methods, particularly in peripheral and inferior regions, but do not
establish that every A 3 PreCore boundary represents the
anatomically optimal contour. Reference-based analyses are required to
determine whether these differences correspond to lower surface error and
improved regional accuracy.

blocks.en:
Finally, the study evaluated brain-mask generation and placement rather than
white-matter-hyperintensity or lesion-segmentation performance. Improved mask
geometry does not necessarily lead to improved lesion sensitivity, regional
burden estimation, or clinical association. A downstream study should apply
the same lesion-segmentation algorithm after BET, fsl_anat , and
A 3 PreCore masking while holding all other settings constant.
Evaluation should include voxelwise and lesion-wise agreement with manual
lesion annotations, regional lesion burden, performance near peripheral and
inferior boundaries, and sensitivity to mask dilation.

blocks.en:
A longer-term goal is to combine full-T 1 anatomical guidance, direct FLAIR
information, automated failure detection, and lesion segmentation within a
unified but modular pipeline. Maintaining separately auditable processing
stages would help determine whether downstream errors originate from
source-mask definition, cross-modal placement, local FLAIR boundary
estimation, QC classification, or lesion segmentation.
blocks.zh:
一个更长期的目标是结合全T 1解剖指导,直接FLAIR
信息、自动故障探测和损伤分解
统一但模块化的管道。 保持可审计的单独处理
阶段将有助于确定下游错误是否源于
源码掩码定义、跨模式放置、当地FLAIR边界
估计、质量控制分类或损伤分解。

blocks.en:
The potential relevance of this framework extends to studies in populations
for whom FLAIR-based lesion assessment is particularly important, including
older adults and individuals with neurological disorders such as cerebral
small-vessel disease, multiple sclerosis, and neurodegenerative conditions.
In these settings, variability in anatomy, lesion burden, acquisition
coverage, and image quality may increase the importance of reliable
participant-specific brain-mask placement. A robust and explicitly
quality-controlled T 1 -to-FLAIR transfer strategy may therefore provide a
more stable preprocessing foundation for subsequent lesion quantification and
regional analyses. Future studies should determine whether these geometric
advantages generalize across clinical populations, scanners, acquisition
protocols, and downstream lesion-segmentation tasks.

blocks.en: 8  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: A 3 PreCore provides a practical, training-free, optimization-based strategy for propagating an established T 1 -derived anatomical brain mask into native FLAIR space. The method estimates a subject-specific six-degree-of-freedom rigid transformation between the fully bias-corrected T 1 -weighted image and native FLAIR using normalized mutual information, jointly optimizing translation and rotation, and then applies the resulting transformation to the T 1 -space anatomical mask.
blocks.zh: A级 3 PreCore提供了一个实用的、无培训的、基于优化的战略,将既定的T 1 -- -- 衍生的解剖脑面具传播到当地FLAIR空间。 该方法估计了完全偏差修正的T 1 - 加权图像与本地FLAIR之间一个针对主题的六度自由的刚性转变,使用正常的相互信息,共同优化翻译和旋转,然后将由此产生的转变应用于T 1 - 空间解剖面具.

blocks.en:
In the present cohort, gross rigid-body placement failures observed
with the implemented fsl_anat were not reproduced by
A 3 PreCore. At the same time, the proposed method
remained closely concordant with successful fsl_anat registrations and
showed high overall agreement with masks generated directly from FLAIR
using BET. These findings demonstrate that technical workflow completion,
native-grid compatibility, and plausible global mask characteristics
alone do not ensure reliable cross-modal mask placement. Assessment of
both translational and rotational geometry is therefore important for
identifying participant-specific registration failures.

The results also support a multidimensional approach to mask
quality-control assessment. Method-specific E-QC descriptors, together
with overlap, boundary, regional, and pairwise geometric measures,
revealed patterns of disagreement that were not apparent from global
mask volume or overlap alone. In particular, centroid displacement,
PCA-derived orientation difference, and orientation-induced boundary
displacement provided complementary information about inter-method
geometry and may help prioritize suspicious outputs for targeted
tri-planar review.

blocks.en: A 3 PreCore should therefore be interpreted as an optimized geometric mask-transfer strategy rather than as a replacement for anatomical brain extraction. Its observed performance reflects the use of full-T 1 spatial support together with normalized-mutual-information-based six-degree-of-freedom rigid optimization of subject-specific translation and rotation. Independent native-FLAIR reference masks and multi-site validation will be required to establish absolute anatomical accuracy and generalizability. Within these limitations, the present findings support A 3 PreCore as a robust, auditable approach to reducing severe cross-modal brain-mask placement failures in native FLAIR preprocessing.
blocks.zh: 因此,3 PreCore应被解释为最优化的几何面具转移策略,而不是取代解剖脑提取. 其观测到的性能反映了对全T1空间支持的运用,以及基于规范的基于六度自由的硬性优化主题翻译和旋转. 需要独立的本土-FLAIR参考口罩和多场验证,以确定绝对解剖精度和通用性. 在这些限制范围内,本结论支持A 3 PreCore,作为减少本地FLAIR预处理中严重跨模式脑罩放置故障的有力、可审计的方法。

blocks.en: S1.1  Sensitivity Analysis of Controlled NMI
blocks.zh: S1.1 受控国家MI的敏感性分析

blocks.en:
To evaluate the dependence of the controlled NMI comparison on voxel
support and histogram discretization, the paired analysis was repeated
across alternative support definitions and histogram-bin settings.
The configured main analysis used common FLAIR-foreground support with
64 histogram bins. Sensitivity analyses were performed using 32, 64,
and 128 bins under four support definitions: common FLAIR foreground,
common non-zero support, common full field of view, and BET-mask support
(Table S1 ;
Figure S1 ).

128 bins. Across the remaining common-support definitions, median
differences ranged from 0.000065 to 0.000256 for common non-zero support

The participant-level direction of the paired NMI difference was more

blocks.en:
Importantly, all 21 participants classified as having gross fsl_anat misregistration retained positive paired NMI
differences across the evaluated common-support configurations.
By contrast, median differences among participants without gross fsl_anat misregistration remained close to zero. This pattern
is consistent with the principal controlled-registration analysis,
indicating that the largest NMI differences were concentrated in the
gross-misregistration subgroup rather than distributed uniformly across
the cohort.

blocks.en:
The influence of individual participants on the configured main-analysis
median was additionally evaluated using leave-one-participant-out
analyses. The full-sample median Δ ​ NMI \Delta\mathrm{NMI} was 0.00006260.

therefore materially determined the cohort median. This analysis addresses
sensitivity to individual participants only and should not be interpreted
as evidence of invariance to voxel-support definition, histogram
resolution, intensity preprocessing, or NMI implementation.

blocks.en: S1.2  Regional and Slice-Wise Spatial Agreement
blocks.zh: S1.2 区域和Slice-Wise空间协定

blocks.en:
Regional and slice-wise analyses were performed to characterize the
spatial distribution of inter-method disagreement beyond whole-mask
overlap. Regional Dice coefficients were calculated after dividing the
mask extent into inferior, middle, and superior thirds along the
inferior–superior anatomical axis. Slice-wise Dice coefficients were
summarized across all evaluable slices along the same axis.
blocks.zh:
进行了区域和片面分析,以说明
超出整体任务范围的方法间分歧的空间分布
重叠。 在除去
下层、中层和上层
低级 - 超高级解剖轴 。 偶数
将同一轴上的所有可评价片段汇总。

blocks.en:
Agreement varied systematically by anatomical region
(Table S2 ). For both comparisons,
the inferior third showed lower Dice agreement than the middle and
superior thirds. This pattern was most pronounced for the
A 3 PreCore–BET comparison, for which the median
inferior-third Dice was 0.870 compared with 0.962 in the middle third
and 0.942 in the superior third. The corresponding values for the
A 3 PreCore– fsl_anat comparison were
0.961, 0.991, and 0.989, respectively.

blocks.en:
The slice-wise summaries showed a similar pattern. Median slice Dice
remained high for both comparisons, whereas the lower-tail
10th-percentile slice Dice was substantially lower, particularly for
A 3 PreCore–BET. These findings indicate that high
overall or median slice agreement can coexist with more pronounced
disagreement in a restricted subset of slices, consistent with the
regional concentration of differences near inferior mask boundaries.

blocks.en: S1.3  Whole-Mask Volume Disagreement
blocks.zh: S1.3 全任务量分歧

blocks.en:
Whole-mask volume differences were examined to determine the extent to
which global mask size reflected spatial disagreement between methods.
Because substantial registration-related displacement or boundary
reconfiguration can occur with little change in total mask volume,
volume-based measures were interpreted jointly with overlap and
boundary-sensitive descriptors.
blocks.zh:
审查了整个任务量的差异,以确定在多大程度上
全球遮盖大小反映了方法之间的空间差异。
因为与登记有关的重大流离失所或边界
在总口罩体积变化不大的情况下,可以进行重组,
以量为基础的措施与重叠和
边界敏感描述符。

blocks.en:
A 3 PreCore and fsl_anat showed minimal
whole-mask volume disagreement despite the presence of substantial
participant-specific spatial discrepancies. The median signed volume
difference was − 0.370 -0.370 mL, and the median absolute difference was
0.464 mL (0.030%). No participant exceeded an absolute volume
difference of 2%, despite 21/78 participants exceeding a normalized
symmetric difference of 0.10 and 21/78 exceeding an HD95 of 5 mm
(Table S3 ).
blocks.zh:
3 PreCore 和 fsl_anat 显示最小值
尽管存在大量争议

(表S.3)。

blocks.en:
The A 3 PreCore–BET comparison showed larger differences
in total mask volume. The median signed difference was − 24.013 -24.013 mL,
the median absolute difference was 30.277 mL, and the median absolute
percentage difference was 2.136%. Forty-one of 78 participants exceeded
an absolute volume difference of 2%. Nevertheless, marked spatial
disagreement was not reducible to volume difference alone: 9/78 participants
exceeded a normalized symmetric difference of 0.10, 12/78 exceeded an
HD95 of 5 mm, and 2/78 exceeded an HD95 of 10 mm.
blocks.zh:
A 3 PreCore-BET 比较显示差异较大
在总口罩体积。 中位数的签名差值为24.013-24.013毫升,

百分比差异为2.136%。 78名参加者中有41名超过

blocks.en:
These findings reinforce the distinction between global mask size and
spatial agreement. In particular, the
A 3 PreCore– fsl_anat comparison demonstrates
that large geometric or boundary discrepancies can occur despite
near-identical total mask volumes when disagreement primarily reflects
translation, orientation, or spatial redistribution rather than net
mask size.
